title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para DevOps Engineer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Title: Lead DevOps Engineer

Location: Brazil

Need someone good with English communication


Role Overview

As a Lead DevOps Engineer, you will refine and enhance CI/CD processes, integrate new capabilities into release pipelines, and drive automation across the software delivery lifecycle. You will also play a key role in embedding AI-driven practices into DevOps, enabling faster and more reliable delivery of data and AI products.

You will work closely with data engineers, platform teams, and product teams to ensure seamless, scalable, and intelligent deployment processes across the Anglo American Data Platform.

Key Responsibilities

DevOps Strategy and Platform Evolution

• Define and implement a modern DevOps and platform engineering strategy aligned with data and AI platform goals.

• Develop roadmaps that incorporate AI-assisted development, testing, and operations .

• Drive the evolution from traditional DevOps to intelligent, self-service platform capabilities .

• Continuously evaluate emerging technologies (e.g., GenAI, LLMOps, AIOps) and incorporate them where relevant.

AI-Enabled CI/CD and Automation

• Design and optimize CI/CD pipelines using AI-assisted tools (e.g., code generation, test generation, pipeline optimization).

• Integrate AI copilots and automation agents into development and deployment workflows.

• Implement intelligent quality gates (e.g., automated code reviews, anomaly detection in pipelines).

• Enable self-healing pipelines and automated failure diagnostics where possible.

Automation and Framework Enhancement

• Build scalable automation frameworks leveraging AI, scripting, and infrastructure as code .

• Automate repetitive tasks using AI agents, prompt-based workflows, or orchestration frameworks .

• Enhance DevOps pipelines to support data products and AI/ML workloads (MLOps/LLMOps) .

• Standardize reusable templates and pipeline components for platform-wide adoption.

Data & AI Platform Integration

Analyze and optimize integrations across the Anglo American Data Platform, including: Databricks (data processing, workflows, DABs)

Airflow (orchestration)

Azure services (compute, storage, identity)

Power BI / downstream consumption layers

Support deployment patterns for AI/ML models, feature pipelines, and inference services .

Enable end-to-end lifecycle management for AI applications (training → deployment → monitoring).

Governance, Security, and Reliability

• Implement governance practices across pipelines, including policy-as-code and automated compliance checks .

• Manage access control and ensure secure DevOps practices across environments.

• Introduce AIOps practices for monitoring, alerting, and incident management.

• Ensure high availability, scalability, and observability of DevOps processes.

Documentation and Developer Experience

• Create and maintain clear documentation, including AI-assisted “how-to” guides and self-service enablement .

• Improve developer experience through intelligent tooling, chat-based interfaces, and automation .

• Promote adoption of DevOps and AI capabilities across teams.

Troubleshooting and Operational Support

• Collaborate with Data Delivery and platform teams to resolve issues efficiently.

• Use AI-assisted diagnostics and root cause analysis tools to accelerate incident resolution.

• Support production environments and ensure stability of pipelines and deployments.

Standards and Best Practices

• Define and promote best practices in DevOps, platform engineering, and AI-enabled delivery.

• Coach teams on adopting modern DevOps + AI approaches .

• Drive consistency and reuse across teams and projects.

Required Skills and Qualifications

Technical Expertise

• Strong experience with CI/CD tools (e.g., Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions).

• Expertise in infrastructure as code (Bicep, ARM or similar).

• Proficiency in scripting (PowerShell, Python, Bash).

• Deep understanding of DevOps principles, Git workflows, and release strategies.

• Experience with Azure services and cloud-native architectures.

• Familiarity with data platforms (Databricks, ADF, Airflow, SQL, AAS or equivalent).

AI & Modern DevOps Capabilities

• Hands-on experience or strong familiarity with: AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, code assistants)

• MLOps / LLMOps concepts (model deployment, monitoring, versioning)

• AIOps tools for monitoring and incident management

•

• Understanding of how AI can be applied to: Code generation and testing

• Pipeline optimization

• Incident detection and resolution

•

• Experience integrating APIs or services for AI capabilities into workflows is a plus.

Platform & Systems Knowledge

• Experience with Azure cloud platform

• Knowledge of data and AI workload deployment patterns.

• Understanding of observability tools and practices.

Problem-Solving and Analytical Skills

• Strong ability to analyze complex systems and improve scalability and performance.

• Proven troubleshooting skills in DevOps and platform environments.

Collaboration and Communication

• Ability to work across technical and business teams.

• Strong communication skills, including documenting and explaining complex concepts.

• Experience enabling teams through tooling and best practices.

Governance and Standards

• Experience with governance frameworks, access control, and compliance.

• Ability to implement and enforce DevOps standards at scale.

Preferred Qualifications

• Azure DevOps Engineer certification or equivalent.

• Experience in enterprise-scale DevOps or platform engineering environments.

• Exposure to data platforms and AI-driven use cases in production.

• Experience with agent-based automation or orchestration frameworks is a plus.

title: Arquiteto de soluções sênior
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Arquiteto de soluções sênior em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Descrição da vaga

A FCamara está em busca de identificar um(a) profissional capaz de compreender a fundo as necessidades do negócio e traduzi-las em soluções de arquitetura robustas, escaláveis e seguras, que agreguem valor à organização.


Compreensão e Análise de Negócio:

➢ Mapear os domínios funcionais relevantes para o negócio.

➢ Definir as capacidades de negócio que cada domínio habilita e como elas contribuem para a geração de valor.

➢ Identificar e detalhar os requisitos (funcionais, negócio, dados, conformidade, leis e regulatórios, etc.).

➢ Detalhamento dos requisitos não funcionais (desempenho, segurança, escalabilidade, etc.) e definição de métricas claras para cada um.

➢ Priorizar os requisitos com base no valor para o negócio e nas restrições técnicas.


Arquitetura e Design da Solução:

➢ Escolher padrões e estilos arquiteturais adequados (micros serviços, filas de mensagens, etc.).

➢ Explicar o motivo da escolha dos estilos e padrões arquiteturais, considerando os requisitos de negócio, as restrições técnicas e os trade-offs envolvidos.

➢ Considerar os trade-offs entre simplicidade e flexibilidade.

➢ Definir estratégias claras para lidar com o aumento da carga (escalabilidade).

➢ Implementar mecanismos de recuperação de falhas (resiliência).

➢ Atender aos requisitos de alta disponibilidade.

➢ Definir como os componentes se comunicam (protocolos, formatos de mensagem, etc).

➢ Escolher ferramentas e padrões de integração adequados e suas responsabilidades.

➢ Implementar autenticação, autorização e criptografia (segurança).

➢ Implementar mecanismos de proteção contra ataques (WAF, etc).

➢ Selecionar ferramentas e tecnologias adequadas para implementar a arquitetura, considerando aspectos como desempenho, custo, facilidade de uso e integração com outros sistemas.

➢ Justificar a escolha de cada ferramenta/tecnologia, demonstrando um entendimento de seus prós e contras.

➢ Demonstrar análise de impacto da solução proposta e em diferentes domínios (Dados, Segurança, Infraestrutura, Soluções e Software, etc.).

➢ Demonstrar a estimativa de custo da solução proposta.

Documentação e Apresentação:

➢ Documentar a arquitetura da solução de forma clara e concisa.

➢ Criar diagramas que representam a arquitetura da solução, incluindo os componentes, suas interações e os fluxos de dados.

➢ Centralizar documentações (Readme).

➢ Descrever possíveis melhorias ou expansões da solução.

➢ Demonstrar capacidade de visão e planejamento a longo prazo.

➢ Discutir trade-offs e desafios enfrentados durante o desenvolvimento.

Implementação e Operação:

➢ Definir métricas de monitoramento para acompanhar o desempenho, a disponibilidade e a segurança da solução.

➢ Implementar alertas para detectar problemas e responder rapidamente.

➢ Descrever ferramentas e técnicas para coletar, analisar e visualizar as métricas.


Requisitos Diferenciais:

➢ Definir os passos para migrar de um sistema de transição para a nova arquitetura (Arquitetura de Transição).

➢ Considerar os riscos e desafios da migração.

➢ Mapear os principais Riscos e Desafios identificados durante a proposta da solução.

➢ Descrever ações mitigatórias para os Riscos e possíveis soluções para os Desafios mapeados.

➢ Demonstrar conhecimento sobre as vantagens e desvantagens das tecnologias escolhidas.

➢ Demonstrar consciência dos tradeoffs envolvidos em cada decisão de arquitetura.

Requisitos e qualificações

Experiência:

➢ Experiência comprovada em projetos de arquitetura de soluções, com foco em integração de sistemas e otimização de processos.

➢ Experiência em análise de requisitos de negócios (funcionais e não funcionais) e transformação em soluções técnicas.

➢ Experiência com a definição e implementação de padrões arquiteturais (microsserviços, filas de mensagens, etc.).

➢ Vivência em ambientes de desenvolvimento ágil.


Conhecimentos Técnicos:

➢ Profundo conhecimento de padrões de integração de sistemas (APIs, mensageria, etc.).

➢ Sólido conhecimento de arquiteturas orientadas a micros serviços.

➢ Familiaridade com diferentes tecnologias e plataformas de desenvolvimento (ex: Java, .NET, Python, Node.js, Cloud, etc.).

➢ Conhecimento de ferramentas de modelagem (ex: UML).

➢ Conhecimento de segurança da informação (autenticação, autorização, criptografia).

➢ Conhecimento de monitoramento e observabilidade de sistemas.

➢ Familiaridade com ferramentas de versionamento de código (ex: Git).

➢ Conhecimento de estimativa de custos de infraestrutura e licenças.

Habilidades :

➢ Excelente capacidade de comunicação e negociação para influenciar stakeholders técnicos e de negócio.

➢ Visão sistêmica e capacidade de análise crítica para identificar oportunidades de melhoria em processos e sistemas.

➢ Habilidade de traduzir requisitos de negócios em especificações técnicas claras e concisas.

➢ Capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas embasadas em dados e em um profundo entendimento dos trade-offs envolvidos.

➢ Habilidade de documentar soluções de forma clara e organizada.

➢ Capacidade de liderar tecnicamente equipes de desenvolvimento.

Habilidades Comportamentais Desejáveis:

➢ Proatividade

➢ Pensamento analítico

➢ Orientação a resultados

➢ Colaboração

➢ Adaptabilidade

➢ Aprendizado contínuo

title: Talent Acquisition Partner
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Talent Acquisition Partner em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Talent Acquisition Partner (Active Sourcing)


Location: Fully Remote (Must be based in LATAM)

Job Type: Full-Time



About Uproot Clean

Uproot Clean is a fast-growing consumer products company with more than 5 million customers using our products. Our products are sold not only through DTC and Amazon, but also through major retailers, including Walmart, Target, and Petco, along with more than 10,000 retail doors across the country. Uproot has also been featured across major television and media platforms, including QVC, Good Morning America, and Fox, helping introduce millions of consumers to the brand.

We care deeply about building products that genuinely solve problems for pet owners while operating with high standards across every part of the business. We are building a company focused on long-term excellence, creating significant opportunities for highly capable people who want real and meaningful impact, and the ability to help shape the future of the company.

About the Role

This is a hands-on execution role focused 100% on active sourcing. You will proactively identify and engage high-quality talent across multiple functions and seniority levels using multiple sourcing channels, advanced search techniques, and thoughtful outreach.

Success requires high-output execution, strong judgment, persistence, excellent communication, and the ability to operate with urgency in a fast-moving environment.



Responsibilities


Active Sourcing

  • Proactively source candidates across multiple job boards, platforms, and sourcing channels
  • Use advanced Boolean search techniques to identify strong talent
  • Build pipelines across multiple functions and seniority levels
  • Identify strong passive candidates
  • Partner closely with recruiting and hiring managers to align on hiring needs.

Candidate Outreach

  • Write outbound messaging that drives candidate engagement
  • Qualify candidates early in the process
  • Move qualified candidates into the recruiting workflow

Pipeline Management

  • Maintain organized sourcing workflows and candidate tracking
  • Continuously improve sourcing strategies and outreach quality
  • Continuously iterate on sourcing methods, messaging, and targeting

What Success Looks Like

  • Consistently builds high-quality candidate pipelines
  • Surfaces strong candidates quickly across multiple functions
  • Generates strong response and assessment completion rates
  • Operates with speed, consistency, and minimal oversight
  • Raises the overall talent bar of the company over time


Requirements

Must Have

  • 1+ year of full-time active sourcing experience - mandatory
  • Experience sourcing across multiple job boards and sourcing platforms
  • Strong outbound recruiting and candidate outreach skills
  • Experience using advanced Boolean search techniques
  • Excellent written English communication skills
  • Ability to manage multiple open searches simultaneously

Strong Plus

  • Experience sourcing across multiple functions and seniority levels
  • Experience in high-growth, e-commerce, or performance-driven companies
  • Familiarity with LinkedIn Recruiter and modern sourcing tools

Work Requirements

⏰ Schedule: Monday-Friday, 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM EST

Workspace: Fixed, professional setup (no digital nomads)

Output: Daily briefs and feedback loops (high consistency required)


Who This Role Is For (& Not For)

This Role Is For You If:

  • You enjoy the challenge of finding exceptional people before anyone else does
  • You are naturally proactive and internally driven
  • You move quickly, stay organized, and maintain high standards
  • You enjoy performance-oriented environments with accountability
  • You think recruiting is a high-leverage business function, not administrative work
  • You enjoy improving systems, processes, and sourcing quality over time

This Role Is NOT For You If:

  • You need constant direction or external motivation
  • You struggle with consistency and follow-through
  • You are uncomfortable persuading passive candidates
  • You treat recruiting as scheduling and coordination only


Compensation & Benefits

Uproot Clean is a high ownership, high accountability environment with high standards for communication, speed, execution, and quality. We care far more about ability, judgment, and ownership than credentials or years of experience.

  • Salary : Competitive base salary + performance-based bonus structure
  • Significant autonomy with the ability to directly influence the company’s growth and direction
  • Fully remote : work from anywhere
  • PTO : 2 Weeks
  • Flex Day : An additional quarterly day off dedicated to rest and recovery
  • Thinking Day: one dedicated day each quarter to step away from day-to-day execution and think deeply about your role, systems, ideas, and long-term impact
  • Wellness Reimbursement: $100-$300/month, based on location, to help support your wellness.
  • Pet Reimbursement: $40-100/month, based on location to help support parenting a pet.
  • Coaching credits: $1,000+/year for coaching, education, and professional development


Ready to Apply?

If you are excited by high standards, proactive recruiting, and the challenge of building world-class talent pipelines, we’d love to hear from you.

CLOSER | EXECUTIVO(A) DE VENDAS CONSULTIVAS | CONECTARIA

Remoto | PJ | Fixo + Comissão + Bônus por Performance


A Conectaria está expandindo sua máquina comercial e busca um(a) Closer de alta performance para atuar na venda da nossa principal mentoria: O Código da Contratação Imediata. Não buscamos alguém apenas “bom de conversa”.


MISSÃO DO CARGO: Transformar leads qualificados em novos mentorados através de uma venda consultiva, estratégica e orientada à decisão.


Buscamos alguém capaz de:

  • sustentar ritmo comercial;
  • conduzir diagnósticos profundos;
  • negociar sem perder valor;
  • lidar bem com pressão;
  • manter previsibilidade;
  • e transformar oportunidades qualificadas em receita consistente.


Seu papel impacta diretamente:

  • crescimento da operação;
  • eficiência comercial;
  • qualidade do funil;
  • e previsibilidade de receita.

  • Conduzir reuniões comerciais diariamente com leads qualificados;
  • Realizar diagnósticos profundos e alinhamento de expectativas;
  • Sustentar follow-ups estratégicos com disciplina;
  • Identificar dores, bloqueios e nível de prontidão do lead;
  • Conduzir negociações mantendo valor e posicionamento;
  • Trabalhar metas claras de receita, fechamento e previsibilidade;
  • Manter CRM atualizado e organizado;
  • Operar com ritmo, autonomia e responsabilidade;
  • Identificar gargalos do funil e oportunidades de melhoria;
  • Representar a marca com comunicação forte, objetiva e profissional.


O QUE ESPERAMOS

  • Alta capacidade de comunicação verbal;
  • Segurança para conduzir conversas difíceis;
  • Organização operacional;
  • Resiliência sob pressão;
  • Capacidade analítica;
  • Ritmo comercial forte;
  • Disciplina com follow-up;
  • Maturidade emocional;
  • Responsabilidade com meta e resultado.


PERFIL IDEAL

  • Experiência mínima de 1–2 anos com vendas consultivas ou closing;
  • Histórico consistente com metas comerciais;
  • Boa capacidade de diagnóstico e negociação;
  • Perfil competitivo e orientado a performance;
  • Capacidade de manter intensidade ao longo da rotina;
  • Facilidade para lidar com objeções;
  • Não depender de supervisão constante;
  • Gostar de ambiente intenso e orientado a resultado.


O QUE NÃO FUNCIONA AQUI

  • Perfil passivo;
  • Dificuldade com cobrança;
  • Sensibilidade excessiva à rejeição;
  • Falta de organização;
  • Comunicação insegura;
  • Dependência emocional constante;
  • Desculpas recorrentes para baixa performance;
  • Perda de ritmo sob pressão;
  • Negociação baseada em desconto;
  • Ego alto sem capacidade operacional.


MODELO DE REMUNERAÇÃO

  • Fixo + Bônus por meta alcançada


Progressão estruturada baseada em:

  • performance;
  • consistência operacional;
  • adaptação à cultura;
  • qualidade de execução;
  • e previsibilidade de resultado.


Quanto maior a capacidade de gerar receita previsível com eficiência, maior o potencial de crescimento dentro da operação. Não temos nenhum medo de te entregar grandes retornos, mas fazemos isso com base em resultados.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer (Golang)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Forward Deployed Engineer (Golang) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Location: Brazil Remote

Department: Engineering

Employment Type: Contract (B2B)

Contract Length: 6 months


About YLD:

Our goal is to help our clients keep moving forward. We work with them to build the skills and capabilities they need to stay ahead of the competition, and we know our success only happens when they succeed. We’re a team of curious, talented people, and we’re committed to making YLD a place where great people want to work, grow, and stay. We’re a remote-first consultancy specialising in software engineering, product design, and data. Our teams are based across London, Lisbon, and Porto, and we create digital solutions that continue to deliver value long after our work is done.


About the role:

As a Forward Deployment Engineer at YLD, you'll be part of a client team building innovative products. We're looking for someone curious, passionate, driven, and enthusiastic. You should be skilled in problem-solving and experienced in designing scalable, resilient, and fault-tolerant architectures. You're also an effective communicator and a strong team player. Together with your team, you'll thrive in a fast-paced engineering environment, delivering outstanding results and exciting projects.


Your day-to-day responsibilities can look like this:

  • Design, build, and maintain robust backend and infrastructure systems using Golang and Java with contributions across the broader engineering stack
  • Work closely with client teams in collaborative working sessions, explaining technical decisions and translating complex engineering concepts clearly
  • Deploy and manage cloud infrastructure across AWS and GCP using Kubernetes (EKS/GKE), Terraform , and Flux
  • Actively leverage AI-powered tools and workflows to accelerate development, improve code quality, and drive engineering best practices


Preferred skills:

  • Strong backend and infrastructure engineering background, with hands-on Golang and Java experience;
  • Experience developing or integrating decentralised systems, data infrastructure, or distributed technologies;
  • Solid command of cloud infrastructure: AWS , GCP , Kubernetes (EKS/GKE), Terraform , and Flux ;
  • Actively and meaningfully using AI tools in day-to-day coding practice (not just awareness, but advanced, habitual use);
  • Familiarity with TigerBeetle, YugabyteDB, or Red Panda;
  • Experience in fintech, core banking, or regulated financial services environments;
  • Open to occasional travel to London.


You should apply if you are:

  • Proactive: You take ownership and move things forward without waiting to be asked;
  • A strong communicator: you express technical ideas clearly, in writing and in client-facing conversations, with full professional fluency in English;
  • Confident presenting: you bring a polished, engaged attitude to working sessions and stakeholder interactions;
  • Focused on quality: you care about doing things properly and hold yourself to a high standard;
  • Pragmatic: you make sensible trade-offs and deliver results in ambiguous, fast-moving environments;
  • A creative problem solver: you approach hard engineering challenges with curiosity and ingenuity;
  • Collaborative: you thrive on working within cross-functional, distributed teams and value others' input.


What you’ll get in return:

  • The chance to work with a forward-thinking, ethical, and fun group of people and to develop and grow your skills in a fast-moving business


Our typical recruitment process:

  • 1st Interview with someone from the Talent team (30/45 mins)
  • Technical Interview with our Senior Developers (1h30)
  • Final chat with our Client Partner (30/45 mins)


Get a glimpse of what it's like working at YLD!

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Project Manager em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Job Title: Project Manager

Location: Remote in Brazil

Duration: 1-year long contract to start


Requirements:

  • Enterprise PM experience: 2–4+ years managing large, high-risk IT projects (data, infrastructure, or application development) in global environments
  • Proven experience with Agile methodologies (Scrum, SAFe preferred), with flexibility to work across Scrum, Kanban, and hybrid environments
  • Full lifecycle ownership: Ability to manage scope, timelines, budgets, and cross-functional teams across multiple concurrent projects (often 3–4 at a time)
  • Strong communication & stakeholder management: Confident interacting across all levels, building relationships, driving accountability, and facilitating Agile ceremonies
  • Bilingual (English, Spanish, Portuguese)

  • Tools & platforms: Experience with Jira, ServiceNow, PowerBI, and collaboration tools like Miro/whiteboarding tools
  • Technical breadth: Exposure to both cloud and on-prem IT initiatives
  • Change management experience: Background in organizational change, adoption strategies, or transformation initiatives



Job Description: A client of Insight Global is seeking a Project Manager to join their team remotely. This individual will manage 3–4 concurrent enterprise IT projects across data, infrastructure, and application development. Day-to-day, they will drive delivery across Agile/Scrum, SAFe, and hybrid teams, lead standups and stakeholder updates, track budgets and timelines, and ensure scope alignment. They will proactively mitigate risks, enforce accountability, and communicate effectively across global teams in English and Spanish/Portuguese.

title: Senior Specialist, Global ICSR
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Specialist, Global ICSR em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Title: Senior Specialist, Global ICSR Case Processing & QC

Department: Global Patient Safety


Overview:

Seeking an experienced Senior Specialist in Global ICSR Case Processing & QC to independently manage the processing and quality control of individual case safety reports (ICSRs), ensuring regulatory compliance and excellence in data accuracy, completeness, and quality. The role includes SAE reconciliation, meeting compliance and productivity targets, and supporting onboarding and training for new team members.


Key Responsibilities:

  • ICSR Case Processing: Manage case processing and quality control of ICSRs from diverse sources (e.g., clinical trials, post-market, literature) to ensure timely, accurate submissions to regulatory authorities.
  • SAE Reconciliation: Perform SAE reconciliations between safety and clinical databases, track progress, resolve issues, and escalate when necessary.
  • Quality & Compliance: Adhere to KPI and quality metrics, ensuring productivity and process improvement within ICSR management.
  • Decision-Making: Execute decisions in line with operational policies, SOPs, and work instructions.
  • Vendor/CRO Coordination: Ensure ICSR activities align with PV agreements and contracts.
  • Training & Onboarding: Develop and update training materials, onboard new team members, provide feedback, and support the onboarding process.


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in life sciences, clinical medicine, nursing, pharmacy, or equivalent experience; advanced degree preferred.
  • Proficiency with Argus safety database and MS Office Suite.
  • Minimum 2 years of experience in drug safety/pharmacovigilance or relevant clinical experience. Preferred 5-8 years of experience
  • Strong understanding of global regulatory requirements (e.g., ICH, FDA, EMA, MHRA) for pharmacovigilance reporting.
  • Excellent communication, problem-solving, time management, and attention to detail.
  • Global cultural awareness and collaborative mindset.

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para \"Consultor SAP ABAP | Fiori #1005140\" em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

A Dexian incentiva a DIVERSIDADE. Nossas oportunidades também estão disponíveis para candidatura de pessoas com deficiência e reabilitados.


Nosso Cliente

Esta vaga irá atender nosso cliente no segmento do Agronegócio.

O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Desenvolver soluções em ABAP (reports, enhancements, BADIs, user-exits, formulários);
  • Desenvolver aplicações SAP Fiori/UI5 com foco em usabilidade e performance;
  • Construir integrações SAP (OData, APIs, IDoc, RFC);
  • Traduzir especificações funcionais em soluções técnicas escaláveis;
  • Realizar análise técnica e propor melhorias de implementação;
  • Garantir qualidade e padronização do código;
  • Apoiar testes unitários e integrados;
  • Corrigir incidentes técnicos e otimizar performance;
  • Documentar tecnicamente as soluções;
  • Colaborar com arquitetura e consultores funcionais.

O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência com desenvolvimento SAP;
  • Experiência com ABAP clássico e Orientação a Objetos;
  • Vivência em SAP S/4HANA.

Hard Skills Obrigatórios

  • Desenvolvimento ABAP;
  • Programação orientada a objetos;
  • Integrações SAP (OData, RFC, IDoc);
  • SAP Fiori/UI5;
  • Modelagem de dados e performance (CDS Views, SQL).

Hard Skills Desejados

  • SAP BTP;
  • Arquitetura SAP Clean Core;
  • CI/CD;
  • Conhecimento funcional em módulos SAP (TM, MM, SD, FI).

Outros Diferenciais

  • Experiência em agronegócio;
  • Integrações complexas e alta volumetria.


Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office.

title: Senior Advanced Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Advanced Analyst em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About us:

Toluna is the global research and insights leader that enables businesses to make smarter, data-driven decisions—faster. For 26 years, we have partnered with the world’s leading brands, delivering transformative impact through our advanced technology platform, comprehensive solution portfolio, expansive global first-party panel, and world-class team of leading research experts. Since 2019, we’ve made significant investments in artificial intelligence to enhance automation, accelerate insight delivery, and unlock deeper understanding at scale. With 40+ offices worldwide, Toluna operates in 70+ countries, redefining the future of insights. Learn


Introduction:

We are seeking a Senior Advanced Analyst to join our global Advanced Analytics team. In this role, you’ll lead the design and execution of advanced analytical solutions that inform strategic decision-making for our clients. You’ll leverage your deep technical expertise and market research experience to drive innovation, mentor junior analysts, and deliver impactful, data-driven recommendations.


This is an exciting opportunity for a passionate analytics professional who thrives at the intersection of data science, business strategy, and storytelling, with growing expectations around applied AI and intelligent automation.


Responsibilities:

  • Lead the design and implementation of advanced analytical frameworks to address complex business challenges across a variety of industries.
  • Partner with internal teams and clients to translate business objectives into analytical solutions, ensuring alignment with strategic priorities.
  • Design, build, and maintain practical analytics-facing AI-enabled solutions such as analytical agents, automated insights generation, or decision support tools using large language models or similar technologies.
  • Evaluate where AI can responsibly augment analytical work, including data preparation, model development, quality checks, insight synthesis, and delivery, while maintaining methodological rigor.

Nice to Have Skills

  • Domain Knowledge: Previous experience working with supply chain, reverse logistics, inventory management, or sustainability/recycling systems.
  • Big Tech Experience: Prior experience working within the ecosystem of a massive, global technology company, understanding the nuances of enterprise-grade security, compliance, and global rollouts.

You will work in a modern, AI-native engineering culture building applied machine learning systems that ship. title: Specialist AI Engineer / Builder (LLM & Healthcare) | Remote Job
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Specialist AI Engineer / Builder (LLM & Healthcare) | Remote Job em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

The Challenge

Every year, the healthcare industry loses billions due to billing failures. We are building the missing link that closes this gap with AI.

We are growing fast, with real operations, active customers, and new partners in the pipeline. We are looking for a builder who wants to help turn our current product into a platform with global scale.


Why This Role Might Be for You

Here, autonomy, ownership, and initiative are part of the daily routine. We are not looking for someone who already knows everything. Not knowing is part of the process. What matters to us is investigative curiosity, strong execution, and a genuine desire to learn.

You will work across both execution and strategy: from writing code to helping shape product and technical decisions. This is a role for someone who can propose new models, spot revenue opportunities, and also dig into data manually when needed to make sure the solution is truly accurate.

Speed, urgency, and attention to detail are essential to how we build.


Key Responsibilities

Your mission will be to help lead the evolution of our AI capabilities.

Today: Execution and Precision

  • Refine and optimize models already in production using AWS Bedrock, continuously improving accuracy and performance.
  • Validate data, rules, and outputs manually when needed. In healthcare, data quality is non-negotiable.
  • Monitor denial patterns and implement fast feedback loops so the system improves continuously.

Tomorrow: Scale and Architecture

  • Help evolve our infrastructure into a robust ecosystem using RAG pipelines and vector databases.
  • Move from a centralized AI solution toward a network of specialized models by context and insurance payer.
  • Contribute to fine-tuning proprietary models using our historical data to create a unique competitive advantage.


What We’re Looking For

  • Investigative curiosity: You want to understand complex medical billing rules and are motivated to master a difficult domain. Healthcare experience is not required.
  • Bias for action: You move fast, take initiative, and understand that speed matters in an early-stage company.
  • Hands-on coding ability: Solid practical experience with Python or Go, plus experience working with LLM APIs such as OpenAI, Anthropic, or AWS Bedrock.
  • Builder mindset: You enjoy creating robust systems from scratch and care deeply about precision, reliability, and business impact.


What We Offer

  • Early-stage impact: Be one of the early team members in a fast-growing company and help shape both the architecture and the culture.
  • High-level technical challenge: Work on real business problems using modern generative AI.
  • Strong team: Work with ambitious, high-performing people who care about building something meaningful.
  • Remote flexibility: 100% remote work, open to candidates based in Brazil.
  • Long-term upside: Potential equity participation for people who help build the business with us.
  • Legacy: Your work will leave a real mark on the product, the codebase, and the company’s story.

title: Talent Acquisition Partner
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Talent Acquisition Partner em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Talent Acquisition Partner (Active Sourcing)


Location: Fully Remote (Must be based in LATAM)

Job Type: Full-Time



About Uproot Clean

Uproot Clean is a fast-growing consumer products company with more than 5 million customers using our products. Our products are sold not only through DTC and Amazon, but also through major retailers, including Walmart, Target, and Petco, along with more than 10,000 retail doors across the country. Uproot has also been featured across major television and media platforms, including QVC, Good Morning America, and Fox, helping introduce millions of consumers to the brand.

We care deeply about building products that genuinely solve problems for pet owners while operating with high standards across every part of the business. We are building a company focused on long-term excellence, creating significant opportunities for highly capable people who want real and meaningful impact, and the ability to help shape the future of the company.

About the Role

This is a hands-on execution role focused 100% on active sourcing. You will proactively identify and engage high-quality talent across multiple functions and seniority levels using multiple sourcing channels, advanced search techniques, and thoughtful outreach.

Success requires high-output execution, strong judgment, persistence, excellent communication, and the ability to operate with urgency in a fast-moving environment.



Responsibilities


Active Sourcing

  • Proactively source candidates across multiple job boards, platforms, and sourcing channels
  • Use advanced Boolean search techniques to identify strong talent
  • Build pipelines across multiple functions and seniority levels
  • Identify strong passive candidates
  • Partner closely with recruiting and hiring managers to align on hiring needs.

Candidate Outreach

  • Write outbound messaging that drives candidate engagement
  • Qualify candidates early in the process
  • Move qualified candidates into the recruiting workflow

Pipeline Management

  • Maintain organized sourcing workflows and candidate tracking
  • Continuously improve sourcing strategies and outreach quality
  • Continuously iterate on sourcing methods, messaging, and targeting

What Success Looks Like

  • Consistently builds high-quality candidate pipelines
  • Surfaces strong candidates quickly across multiple functions
  • Generates strong response and assessment completion rates
  • Operates with speed, consistency, and minimal oversight
  • Raises the overall talent bar of the company over time


Requirements

Must Have

  • 1+ year of full-time active sourcing experience - mandatory
  • Experience sourcing across multiple job boards and sourcing platforms
  • Strong outbound recruiting and candidate outreach skills
  • Experience using advanced Boolean search techniques
  • Excellent written English communication skills
  • Ability to manage multiple open searches simultaneously

Strong Plus

  • Experience sourcing across multiple functions and seniority levels
  • Experience in high-growth, e-commerce, or performance-driven companies
  • Familiarity with LinkedIn Recruiter and modern sourcing tools

Work Requirements

⏰ Schedule: Monday-Friday, 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM EST

Workspace: Fixed, professional setup (no digital nomads)

Output: Daily briefs and feedback loops (high consistency required)


Who This Role Is For (& Not For)

This Role Is For You If:

  • You enjoy the challenge of finding exceptional people before anyone else does
  • You are naturally proactive and internally driven
  • You move quickly, stay organized, and maintain high standards
  • You enjoy performance-oriented environments with accountability
  • You think recruiting is a high-leverage business function, not administrative work
  • You enjoy improving systems, processes, and sourcing quality over time

This Role Is NOT For You If:

  • You need constant direction or external motivation
  • You struggle with consistency and follow-through
  • You are uncomfortable persuading passive candidates
  • You treat recruiting as scheduling and coordination only


Compensation & Benefits

Uproot Clean is a high ownership, high accountability environment with high standards for communication, speed, execution, and quality. We care far more about ability, judgment, and ownership than credentials or years of experience.

  • Salary : Competitive base salary + performance-based bonus structure
  • Significant autonomy with the ability to directly influence the company’s growth and direction
  • Fully remote : work from anywhere
  • PTO : 2 Weeks
  • Flex Day : An additional quarterly day off dedicated to rest and recovery
  • Thinking Day: one dedicated day each quarter to step away from day-to-day execution and think deeply about your role, systems, ideas, and long-term impact
  • Wellness Reimbursement: $100-$300/month, based on location, to help support your wellness.
  • Pet Reimbursement: $40-100/month, based on location to help support parenting a pet.
  • Coaching credits: $1,000+/year for coaching, education, and professional development


Ready to Apply?

If you are excited by high standards, proactive recruiting, and the challenge of building world-class talent pipelines, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Senior Product Designer (UX/UI)
description:

About Foundey


Foundey (formerly Uitify) is a design studio specializing in delivering high-quality UI/UX and branding solutions for early-stage SaaS startups based in the United States. We are committed to transforming complex business ideas into elegant, user-centric digital experiences. With a strong emphasis on design excellence, innovation, and client collaboration, we help fast-growing companies establish strong visual identities and seamless digital products.


The Opportunity


We are looking for a experienced and strategic Product Designer. This role is ideal for a designer who thrives on solving complex user problems, designing for technical audiences, and delivering intuitive, scalable product experiences in fast-paced, startup environments.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on product thinker with a deep understanding of user-centered design for B2B software, a track record of shipping enterprise-grade digital products, and experience working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and key stakeholders in the cybersecurity and SaaS sectors.


Responsibilities


  • Lead end-to-end product design processes, from discovery and research to wireframing, prototyping, and high-fidelity UI design;
  • Partner closely with Product Management and Engineering to define product requirements and translate them into user-centered design solutions;
  • Design intuitive interfaces for complex cybersecurity tools and SaaS products, focusing on usability, scalability, and performance;
  • Conduct user research, usability testing, and heuristic evaluations to validate design decisions and optimize user experience
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to align design goals with business objectives, technical constraints, and customer needs;
  • Create and maintain design systems and UI libraries to ensure consistency and efficiency across the product suite;
  • Stay updated on design trends, user behavior patterns in B2B software, and industry best practices in product design;
  • Mentor junior designers and provide design critique and feedback within the team.


Requirements


  • Full professional proficiency in English (verbal and written), with the ability to clearly articulate design rationale and collaborate with international teams;
  • Strong portfolio showcasing complex product design work for enterprise software, especially in security, data visualization, or technical tools;
  • Deep expertise with design tools like Figma, FigJam, and prototyping tools such as Framer or Principle;
  • Solid understanding of user flows, interaction design, information architecture, and visual hierarchy for B2B software;
  • Experience working in agile development environments, with strong collaboration skills alongside Product Managers and Engineers;
  • Familiarity with design systems, accessibility standards (WCAG), and responsive design principles.


Preferred Qualifications


  • 6+ years of experience as a Product Designer
  • Direct experience designing for cybersecurity platforms (e.g., threat detection tools, security dashboards, monitoring platforms, etc.);
  • Background in designing data-heavy interfaces, with complex user journeys and role-based user permissions;
  • Knowledge of frontend development principles (HTML, CSS) to effectively communicate with developers;
  • Prior experience working with US-based startups or product teams;
  • Experience facilitating design workshops, user interviews, or stakeholder alignment sessions.


Why Join Us?


At Foundey, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing SaaS and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. You’ll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.

title: Arquiteto de soluções sênior
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Arquiteto de soluções sênior em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Descrição da vaga

A FCamara está em busca de identificar um(a) profissional capaz de compreender a fundo as necessidades do negócio e traduzi-las em soluções de arquitetura robustas, escaláveis e seguras, que agreguem valor à organização.


Compreensão e Análise de Negócio:

➢ Mapear os domínios funcionais relevantes para o negócio.

➢ Definir as capacidades de negócio que cada domínio habilita e como elas contribuem para a geração de valor.

➢ Identificar e detalhar os requisitos (funcionais, negócio, dados, conformidade, leis e regulatórios, etc.).

➢ Detalhamento dos requisitos não funcionais (desempenho, segurança, escalabilidade, etc.) e definição de métricas claras para cada um.

➢ Priorizar os requisitos com base no valor para o negócio e nas restrições técnicas.


Arquitetura e Design da Solução:

➢ Escolher padrões e estilos arquiteturais adequados (micros serviços, filas de mensagens, etc.).

➢ Explicar o motivo da escolha dos estilos e padrões arquiteturais, considerando os requisitos de negócio, as restrições técnicas e os trade-offs envolvidos.

➢ Considerar os trade-offs entre simplicidade e flexibilidade.

➢ Definir estratégias claras para lidar com o aumento da carga (escalabilidade).

➢ Implementar mecanismos de recuperação de falhas (resiliência).

➢ Atender aos requisitos de alta disponibilidade.

➢ Definir como os componentes se comunicam (protocolos, formatos de mensagem, etc).

➢ Escolher ferramentas e padrões de integração adequados e suas responsabilidades.

➢ Implementar autenticação, autorização e criptografia (segurança).

➢ Implementar mecanismos de proteção contra ataques (WAF, etc).

➢ Selecionar ferramentas e tecnologias adequadas para implementar a arquitetura, considerando aspectos como desempenho, custo, facilidade de uso e integração com outros sistemas.

➢ Justificar a escolha de cada ferramenta/tecnologia, demonstrando um entendimento de seus prós e contras.

➢ Demonstrar análise de impacto da solução proposta e em diferentes domínios (Dados, Segurança, Infraestrutura, Soluções e Software, etc.).

➢ Demonstrar a estimativa de custo da solução proposta.

Documentação e Apresentação:

➢ Documentar a arquitetura da solução de forma clara e concisa.

➢ Criar diagramas que representam a arquitetura da solução, incluindo os componentes, suas interações e os fluxos de dados.

➢ Centralizar documentações (Readme).

➢ Descrever possíveis melhorias ou expansões da solução.

➢ Demonstrar capacidade de visão e planejamento a longo prazo.

➢ Discutir trade-offs e desafios enfrentados durante o desenvolvimento.

Implementação e Operação:

➢ Definir métricas de monitoramento para acompanhar o desempenho, a disponibilidade e a segurança da solução.

➢ Implementar alertas para detectar problemas e responder rapidamente.

➢ Descrever ferramentas e técnicas para coletar, analisar e visualizar as métricas.


Requisitos Diferenciais:

➢ Definir os passos para migrar de um sistema de transição para a nova arquitetura (Arquitetura de Transição).

➢ Considerar os riscos e desafios da migração.

➢ Mapear os principais Riscos e Desafios identificados durante a proposta da solução.

➢ Descrever ações mitigatórias para os Riscos e possíveis soluções para os Desafios mapeados.

➢ Demonstrar conhecimento sobre as vantagens e desvantagens das tecnologias escolhidas.

➢ Demonstrar consciência dos tradeoffs envolvidos em cada decisão de arquitetura.

Requisitos e qualificações

Experiência:

➢ Experiência comprovada em projetos de arquitetura de soluções, com foco em integração de sistemas e otimização de processos.

➢ Experiência em análise de requisitos de negócios (funcionais e não funcionais) e transformação em soluções técnicas.

➢ Experiência com a definição e implementação de padrões arquiteturais (microsserviços, filas de mensagens, etc.).

➢ Vivência em ambientes de desenvolvimento ágil.


Conhecimentos Técnicos:

➢ Profundo conhecimento de padrões de integração de sistemas (APIs, mensageria, etc.).

➢ Sólido conhecimento de arquiteturas orientadas a micros serviços.

➢ Familiaridade com diferentes tecnologias e plataformas de desenvolvimento (ex: Java, .NET, Python, Node.js, Cloud, etc.).

➢ Conhecimento de ferramentas de modelagem (ex: UML).

➢ Conhecimento de segurança da informação (autenticação, autorização, criptografia).

➢ Conhecimento de monitoramento e observabilidade de sistemas.

➢ Familiaridade com ferramentas de versionamento de código (ex: Git).

➢ Conhecimento de estimativa de custos de infraestrutura e licenças.

Habilidades :

➢ Excelente capacidade de comunicação e negociação para influenciar stakeholders técnicos e de negócio.

➢ Visão sistêmica e capacidade de análise crítica para identificar oportunidades de melhoria em processos e sistemas.

➢ Habilidade de traduzir requisitos de negócios em especificações técnicas claras e concisas.

➢ Capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas embasadas em dados e em um profundo entendimento dos trade-offs envolvidos.

➢ Habilidade de documentar soluções de forma clara e organizada.

➢ Capacidade de liderar tecnicamente equipes de desenvolvimento.

Habilidades Comportamentais Desejáveis:

➢ Proatividade

➢ Pensamento analítico

➢ Orientação a resultados

➢ Colaboração

➢ Adaptabilidade

➢ Aprendizado contínuo

Preferred Qualifications

At Foundey, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing SaaS and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. description:

O dia a dia inclui desde a modelagem e transformação de dados até a entrega de dashboards e relatórios que suportem a tomada de decisão. A pessoa ideal combina domínio técnico em ferramentas de BI com sólida experiência em SQL e scripting para manipulação de dados em escala.


Responsabilidades

  • Projetar, desenvolver e manter dashboards, relatórios e soluções analíticas em Power BI ou Qlik (Sense/SaaS) .
  • Escrever e otimizar queries complexas em SQL para extração, transformação e carga de dados (ETL/ELT).
  • Modelar dados dimensionais e relacionais, garantindo performance e escalabilidade das soluções.
  • Desenvolver e manter pipelines de dados utilizando scripts em SQL, Python ou outras linguagens pertinentes.
  • Conectar e integrar múltiplas fontes de dados (bancos relacionais, APIs, arquivos flat, data lakes).
  • Documentar processos, modelos de dados e regras de negócio de forma clara e acessível.
  • Colaborar com times multidisciplinares (produto, engenharia, negócios) para traduzir necessidades em soluções de dados.
  • Participar de code reviews e contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos de dados.


Requisitos

  • Experiência consolidada (3+ anos) com desenvolvimento de BI e/ou engenharia de dados.
  • Domínio avançado de SQL (CTEs, window functions, otimização de queries, stored procedures).
  • Experiência prática com Power BI (DAX, Power Query/M) e/ou Qlik (script de carga, set analysis).
  • Conhecimento em modelagem de dados (star schema, snowflake, Data Vault).
  • Experiência com pelo menos um banco de dados relacional (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle ou similar).
  • Familiaridade com conceitos e ferramentas de ETL/ELT.
  • Inglês avançado ou fluente, uso diário em reuniões e comunicação com times internacionais.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência com Python para manipulação e automação de dados.
  • Vivência com plataformas de dados em nuvem (especialmente Snowflake).
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de orquestração (Airflow, dbt, Azure Data Factory, SSIS).
  • Experiência com versionamento de código (Git).
  • Familiaridade com práticas de DataOps e CI/CD aplicadas a dados.


O que oferecemos

  • Trabalho 100% remoto.
  • Contratação PJ com remuneração competitiva.
  • Flexibilidade de horário.
  • Ambiente colaborativo e orientado a dados.
  • Programa de capacitação continuada.
  • Oportunidade de crescimento e atuação em projetos internacionais e desafiadores.

title: Emerging Market Trader
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Emerging Market Trader em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African/LATAM/Asian currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties.



Key Responsibilities

FX Trading & Liquidity Management

  • Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies , with a focus on African (e.g., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS), LATAM (ARS, BRL, MXN) and/or Asian (IDR, VDN, etc.) on markets.
  • Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks across relevant regions.
  • Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure.
  • Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics across EM FX markets.


Hedging Strategy & Risk Management

  • Design and implement FX hedging strategies to manage corporate or client-driven exposures.
  • Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools where relevant.
  • Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization .
  • Monitor risk limits, PnL, and exposure across currency books.


Trading Infrastructure & Systems

  • Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure , including:
  • Automated hedging engines
  • Liquidity aggregation systems
  • Smart order routing
  • Pricing and risk management tools
  • Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers via APIs or FIX protocols.
  • Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring .


Market Development

  • Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners across emerging markets.
  • Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs and support new corridor launches.
  • Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure supporting global payments and settlement flows.



Requirements

Experience

  • 5–10+ years of FX trading experience in Emerging Markets.
  • Strong experience trading African currencies , such as:
  • Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP
  • Experience working at:
  • Global banks
  • EM FX trading firms
  • Payment / fintech companies
  • Crypto exchanges or market makers
  • Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades .


Technical Expertise

  • Deep understanding of:
  • FX market microstructure in illiquid markets
  • NDF markets and offshore hedging
  • Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks
  • Hands-on experience building or optimizing:
  • FX trading systems
  • Hedging engines
  • Liquidity aggregation platforms
  • Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution .


Skills

  • Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities.
  • Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments .
  • Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks .
  • Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations .
  • Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources .
  • Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies .
  • Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations .
  • Strong analytical and problem solving skills
  • Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments



Vision & Mission

  • OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
  • OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: K-POP Influencers
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para K-POP Influencers em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. K-POP & K-DRAMA Influencer Growth CreatorPowered by IZISURFAbout IZISURF

IZISURF is building a next-generation creator growth ecosystem focused on K-POP, K-Drama, Korean entertainment, and global fan communities. Our mission is to help passionate creators transform their content into scalable global media brands through audience growth, AI-powered optimization, fan engagement strategies, and cross-platform expansion.

We believe that the future of entertainment media belongs to creators who deeply understand fandom culture, digital storytelling, and internet trends. As Korean entertainment continues to influence global culture, we are creating an infrastructure that helps influencers grow faster, engage audiences more effectively, and unlock meaningful monetization opportunities.

Unlike traditional influencer agencies, IZISURF operates as a creator growth partner. We actively work alongside creators to optimize content performance, identify viral opportunities, improve audience retention, and expand creator reach across multiple social media platforms. Our goal is not only to help creators gain followers, but to help them build long-term digital brands with sustainable growth.

Position Overview

We are looking for highly creative, trend-aware, and passionate K-POP & K-Drama Influencer Growth Creators who are excited about Korean entertainment culture and want to build a strong global online presence.

This role is ideal for individuals who genuinely enjoy discussing K-POP groups, idols, dramas, entertainment news, fan theories, comeback analysis, performances, concerts, and online fandom culture. Whether you are already an influencer or an emerging creator with strong potential, we are interested in working with people who can create authentic and engaging content that resonates with audiences worldwide.

As part of IZISURF, creators will receive strategic support designed to accelerate growth. Our team helps creators improve audience engagement, optimize content formats, analyze performance metrics, and identify viral content opportunities. We work collaboratively with creators to develop sustainable content strategies rather than focusing only on short-term trends.

Responsibilities

The selected creator will regularly produce engaging content related to K-POP, K-Dramas, Korean celebrities, entertainment culture, idol trends, music releases, and fan discussions. Content may include reactions, commentary, reviews, rankings, livestream discussions, entertainment analysis, short-form videos, and community engagement activities.

Creators will publish content across platforms such as TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, YouTube, X (Twitter), Threads, and other emerging media channels. The role requires staying highly informed about ongoing entertainment trends, comeback schedules, drama releases, viral online discussions, and fandom activities.

In addition to content production, creators will collaborate closely with the IZISURF growth team to improve visibility and engagement. This includes reviewing analytics, refining content strategy, experimenting with new content formats, and participating in cross-platform growth campaigns. We encourage creators to continuously evolve their personal brand while maintaining authenticity and strong audience connection.

Creators may also participate in brand collaborations, entertainment campaigns, livestream events, fan engagement projects, and promotional activities related to Korean entertainment and digital culture.

What Makes This Opportunity Different

At IZISURF, we do not simply recruit influencers — we actively help creators grow.

Our team provides strategic support in audience development, content optimization, social media analytics, trend intelligence, and creator branding. We help creators identify what content performs best, how to improve audience retention, and how to scale engagement across multiple platforms.

Creators working with IZISURF may gain access to growth resources, collaboration opportunities, creator partnerships, AI-assisted content workflows, monetization strategies, and entertainment-related campaigns designed to increase visibility and accelerate growth.

We believe that many talented creators struggle not because of creativity, but because they lack access to proper growth infrastructure. IZISURF is designed to solve that problem by combining entertainment culture expertise with modern digital growth systems.

Preferred Qualifications

We are looking for individuals who are highly passionate about Korean entertainment culture and actively follow K-POP, K-Dramas, Korean celebrities, and fandom communities. Strong communication skills, creativity, consistency, and comfort appearing on camera are highly valuable for this role.

Experience with social media content creation is preferred, but we are also open to emerging creators who demonstrate strong potential, personality, and storytelling ability. Familiarity with short-form video platforms, editing tools, and internet culture trends is important.

Candidates who already maintain active social media accounts, fan communities, or entertainment-focused content channels are strongly encouraged to apply. Korean language skills are a plus but are not required.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is someone who genuinely enjoys talking about Korean entertainment and naturally engages with online communities. You are someone who understands internet culture, stays updated on trends, and enjoys creating content that sparks discussion and engagement.

You are creative, ambitious, and interested in building a long-term digital presence rather than simply posting occasional entertainment updates. You are excited about growing alongside a team that actively supports creator development and digital brand expansion.

Most importantly, you understand fandom culture and can create content that feels authentic, relatable, and engaging to global audiences.

title: Arquiteto de soluções sênior
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Arquiteto de soluções sênior em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Descrição da vaga

A FCamara está em busca de identificar um(a) profissional capaz de compreender a fundo as necessidades do negócio e traduzi-las em soluções de arquitetura robustas, escaláveis e seguras, que agreguem valor à organização.


Compreensão e Análise de Negócio:

➢ Mapear os domínios funcionais relevantes para o negócio.

➢ Definir as capacidades de negócio que cada domínio habilita e como elas contribuem para a geração de valor.

➢ Identificar e detalhar os requisitos (funcionais, negócio, dados, conformidade, leis e regulatórios, etc.).

➢ Detalhamento dos requisitos não funcionais (desempenho, segurança, escalabilidade, etc.) e definição de métricas claras para cada um.

➢ Priorizar os requisitos com base no valor para o negócio e nas restrições técnicas.


Arquitetura e Design da Solução:

➢ Escolher padrões e estilos arquiteturais adequados (micros serviços, filas de mensagens, etc.).

➢ Explicar o motivo da escolha dos estilos e padrões arquiteturais, considerando os requisitos de negócio, as restrições técnicas e os trade-offs envolvidos.

➢ Considerar os trade-offs entre simplicidade e flexibilidade.

➢ Definir estratégias claras para lidar com o aumento da carga (escalabilidade).

➢ Implementar mecanismos de recuperação de falhas (resiliência).

➢ Atender aos requisitos de alta disponibilidade.

➢ Definir como os componentes se comunicam (protocolos, formatos de mensagem, etc).

➢ Escolher ferramentas e padrões de integração adequados e suas responsabilidades.

➢ Implementar autenticação, autorização e criptografia (segurança).

➢ Implementar mecanismos de proteção contra ataques (WAF, etc).

➢ Selecionar ferramentas e tecnologias adequadas para implementar a arquitetura, considerando aspectos como desempenho, custo, facilidade de uso e integração com outros sistemas.

➢ Justificar a escolha de cada ferramenta/tecnologia, demonstrando um entendimento de seus prós e contras.

➢ Demonstrar análise de impacto da solução proposta e em diferentes domínios (Dados, Segurança, Infraestrutura, Soluções e Software, etc.).

➢ Demonstrar a estimativa de custo da solução proposta.

Documentação e Apresentação:

➢ Documentar a arquitetura da solução de forma clara e concisa.

➢ Criar diagramas que representam a arquitetura da solução, incluindo os componentes, suas interações e os fluxos de dados.

➢ Centralizar documentações (Readme).

➢ Descrever possíveis melhorias ou expansões da solução.

➢ Demonstrar capacidade de visão e planejamento a longo prazo.

➢ Discutir trade-offs e desafios enfrentados durante o desenvolvimento.

Implementação e Operação:

➢ Definir métricas de monitoramento para acompanhar o desempenho, a disponibilidade e a segurança da solução.

➢ Implementar alertas para detectar problemas e responder rapidamente.

➢ Descrever ferramentas e técnicas para coletar, analisar e visualizar as métricas.


Requisitos Diferenciais:

➢ Definir os passos para migrar de um sistema de transição para a nova arquitetura (Arquitetura de Transição).

➢ Considerar os riscos e desafios da migração.

➢ Mapear os principais Riscos e Desafios identificados durante a proposta da solução.

title: Talent Acquisition Partner
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Talent Acquisition Partner em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Talent Acquisition Partner (Active Sourcing)


Location: Fully Remote (Must be based in LATAM)

Job Type: Full-Time



About Uproot Clean

Uproot Clean is a fast-growing consumer products company with more than 5 million customers using our products. Our products are sold not only through DTC and Amazon, but also through major retailers, including Walmart, Target, and Petco, along with more than 10,000 retail doors across the country. Uproot has also been featured across major television and media platforms, including QVC, Good Morning America, and Fox, helping introduce millions of consumers to the brand.

We care deeply about building products that genuinely solve problems for pet owners while operating with high standards across every part of the business. We are building a company focused on long-term excellence, creating significant opportunities for highly capable people who want real and meaningful impact, and the ability to help shape the future of the company.

About the Role

This is a hands-on execution role focused 100% on active sourcing. You will proactively identify and engage high-quality talent across multiple functions and seniority levels using multiple sourcing channels, advanced search techniques, and thoughtful outreach.

Success requires high-output execution, strong judgment, persistence, excellent communication, and the ability to operate with urgency in a fast-moving environment.



Responsibilities


Active Sourcing

  • Proactively source candidates across multiple job boards, platforms, and sourcing channels
  • Use advanced Boolean search techniques to identify strong talent
  • Build pipelines across multiple functions and seniority levels
  • Identify strong passive candidates
  • Partner closely with recruiting and hiring managers to align on hiring needs.

Candidate Outreach

  • Write outbound messaging that drives candidate engagement
  • Qualify candidates early in the process
  • Move qualified candidates into the recruiting workflow

Pipeline Management

  • Maintain organized sourcing workflows and candidate tracking
  • Continuously improve sourcing strategies and outreach quality
  • Continuously iterate on sourcing methods, messaging, and targeting

What Success Looks Like

  • Consistently builds high-quality candidate pipelines
  • Surfaces strong candidates quickly across multiple functions
  • Generates strong response and assessment completion rates
  • Operates with speed, consistency, and minimal oversight
  • Raises the overall talent bar of the company over time


Requirements

Must Have

  • 1+ year of full-time active sourcing experience - mandatory
  • Experience sourcing across multiple job boards and sourcing platforms
  • Strong outbound recruiting and candidate outreach skills
  • Experience using advanced Boolean search techniques
  • Excellent written English communication skills
  • Ability to manage multiple open searches simultaneously

Strong Plus

  • Experience sourcing across multiple functions and seniority levels
  • Experience in high-growth, e-commerce, or performance-driven companies
  • Familiarity with LinkedIn Recruiter and modern sourcing tools

Work Requirements

⏰ Schedule: Monday-Friday, 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM EST

Workspace: Fixed, professional setup (no digital nomads)

Output: Daily briefs and feedback loops (high consistency required)


Who This Role Is For (& Not For)

This Role Is For You If:

  • You enjoy the challenge of finding exceptional people before anyone else does
  • You are naturally proactive and internally driven
  • You move quickly, stay organized, and maintain high standards
  • You enjoy performance-oriented environments with accountability
  • You think recruiting is a high-leverage business function, not administrative work
  • You enjoy improving systems, processes, and sourcing quality over time

This Role Is NOT For You If:

  • You need constant direction or external motivation
  • You struggle with consistency and follow-through
  • You are uncomfortable persuading passive candidates
  • You treat recruiting as scheduling and coordination only


Compensation & Benefits

Uproot Clean is a high ownership, high accountability environment with high standards for communication, speed, execution, and quality. We care far more about ability, judgment, and ownership than credentials or years of experience.

  • Salary : Competitive base salary + performance-based bonus structure
  • Significant autonomy with the ability to directly influence the company’s growth and direction
  • Fully remote : work from anywhere
  • PTO : 2 Weeks
  • Flex Day : An additional quarterly day off dedicated to rest and recovery
  • Thinking Day: one dedicated day each quarter to step away from day-to-day execution and think deeply about your role, systems, ideas, and long-term impact
  • Wellness Reimbursement: $100-$300/month, based on location, to help support your wellness.
  • Pet Reimbursement: $40-100/month, based on location to help support parenting a pet.
  • Coaching credits: $1,000+/year for coaching, education, and professional development


Ready to Apply?

If you are excited by high standards, proactive recruiting, and the challenge of building world-class talent pipelines, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Senior Cisco UCS Engineer (REMOTE)
